item.title: Eastern North Pacific Tropical Weather Outlook
item.description:
248
ABPZ20 KNHC 050508
TWOEP

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
1100 PM PDT Fri Sep 4 2026

For the eastern and central North Pacific east of 180 longitude:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Hurricane
Karina, located several hundred miles east of the Hawaiian Islands,
on Hurricane Lowell, located several hundred miles south-southwest
of the Hawaiian Islands, and on Hurricane Marie, located several
hundred miles west-southwest of the southern tip of the Baja
California Peninsula.

Offshore of Southwestern Mexico:
An area of low pressure may develop well offshore of southwestern
Mexico early next week. Gradual development is possible, and a
tropical depression could form around the middle of next week while
it moves west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...medium...60 percent.

$$
Forecaster Pierce/Gibbs

item.title: Summary for Hurricane Marie (EP3/EP132026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...MARIE WEAKENS A LITTLE AS IT MOVES NORTHWESTWARD... As of 2:00 AM PDT Sat Sep 05 the center of Marie was located near 21.4, -119.7 with movement NW at 8 mph. The minimum central pressure was 970 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 90 mph.
